description: Colorful sticky notes on a board — add, edit, recolor and delete notes. Everything auto-saves in your browser.

faqs.a: Yes — notes are saved in localStorage and restored on every visit, edits included.
Six colors: yellow, pink, green, blue, purple and orange.
Click a note's text to edit it inline — changes save automatically.
Yes — the board wraps nicely on small screens.

howto: Type your note — it saves as you type.
Change its color from the palette.
Delete notes you no longer need.
title: Sticky Notes App
